Want your life to change? Start with the one thing you control.

Kevin Trudeau explains that if you want things in your life to change, you have to change things in your life. The number one job, he says, is working on being a better you, not cutting ties or trying to change anybody else.

He says that when you change from the inside, the relationship changes too. And even when other people stay the same, how you respond to them can shift completely.

Which relationship would feel different if you responded differently?
